derived.zh: 官方模型卡 cardData 声明 base_model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B —— 本站按 A6.5 口径把它标为「派生自 Qwen 系」：权重谱系上它是 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 SFT/RL 后训练产物，不是从零预训练。
derived.en: The official model card declares base_model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B — under this site's A6.5 convention it is marked as derived from the Qwen line: on the weight lineage it is an SFT/RL post-train of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, not trained from scratch.

generations.zh: 当前代。官方 README：V2.5 于 2026-07 发布（闭源 API 版），开放权重的 V2.5-Dev 为 35B 总参 / 3B 激活 MoE，经 SFT/RL 训练；模型卡声明派生自 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。
generations.en: Current generation. Official README: V2.5 shipped July 2026 (closed API); the open-weight V2.5-Dev is a 35B-total / 3B-active MoE trained with SFT/RL; the model card declares it derived from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.

generations.zh: 更早一代（KAT-V1-40B 仓 2025-08 出现在官方 org）。
generations.en: Earlier line (the KAT-V1-40B repo appeared in the official org in August 2025).

sizeTiers.zh: 代码专用 35B-A3B（35B 总参 / 3B 激活）

licenses.zh: Apache-2.0（V2.5-Dev 开放权重版；V2.5 完整版走 API，不开权重）
licenses.en: Apache-2.0 (the open-weight V2.5-Dev; the full V2.5 stays behind the API)

claims.zh: 官方 README：「an MOE model with a total parameter count of 35B and 3B activated parameters」「Through SFT/RL training, KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev achieves SOTA results … among models with similar parameter scales」——SOTA 为厂商自评基准口径。
claims.en: Official README: "an MOE model with a total parameter count of 35B and 3B activated parameters"; "Through SFT/RL training, KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev achieves SOTA results … among models with similar parameter scales" — the SOTA claim is vendor-run benchmark wording.

positioning.zh: 快手 Kwaipilot 的代码家族：API 版闭源、Dev 版开放权重。它是本站收录的「派生模型」代表——官方自己声明基座是 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，选它等于选 Qwen 谱系 + 快手代码后训练。
positioning.en: Kuaishou Kwaipilot's coding line: the API build stays closed, the Dev build is open-weight. It is this site's representative "derived model" — the vendor itself declares Qwen3.6-35B-A3B as its base, so choosing it means choosing the Qwen lineage plus Kuaishou's code post-training.

onSite.zh: 本站已收录 KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev 的量化对比
